content_md: [Freud](https://ammdi.hyperphor.com/Freud) is out of fashion but this is mostly what he was trying to investigate (focusing on the pathologies of the process of course, because they are easier to see than the normal cases). Rationalism is pretty pathological in its denial of desire, which also probably explains why it has [morphed into a sex cult](https://www.verysane.ai/p/ai-safety-is-mostly-a-sex-cult-in-berkeley-california) via enantiodromia.
